summary: The PHP SDK's search attribute type parser is too strict and needs to be made more lenient to match behavior in other language SDKs. This issue references a fix that was already implemented in other languages (features issue #741).
userImpact: Users experience inconsistent search attribute type handling between PHP SDK and other language SDKs, reducing cross-language compatibility.
rootCause: The PHP SDK's search attribute type parser enforces overly strict type validation compared to other SDK implementations.
proposedFix: Apply the same lenient type parsing behavior that was implemented in other language SDKs per features issue #741.
resolutionDetails: Applied the same lenient search attribute type parsing fix that was implemented across other SDK language implementations.
keyQuote: Need to make the same fix as done in other languages for https://github.com/temporalio/features/issues/741
